record.body:
## Rationale

The user chose to batch manual sign-offs at the end. Phase 1 has every automated check passing; only the manual live-render check waits for a signature. Holding phase 2 for one signature would stall the run with no gain in safety.

## Counter-argument

Two phases in progress at once breaks the one-current-phase model that plan-phase and execute-phase assume. A reviewer might reject the live render and force rework in phase 1 after phase 2 builds on it.

payload.alternatives: stop and ask for the signature now, close phase 1 without the signature
payload.choice: Keep dashboard-view in_progress until the user signs its manual check; start watch-renderer now

record.subject: phase-1-open-pending-signature
